items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Beverly for the past few years has been the bassist with the great Bobby Short

ctx.x: It turned out that Daisy, this dancer, broke her spine, broke it in three places, which meant a never walk again situation. Joe had broken a bone in his cheek, he had a broken bone in his hip and some other lacerations that I don't remember. Anyway, it was a situation where the result was that he was in the hospital for the next I guess three or four months at least. Of course, Daisy, the dancer, was in there for the next two or three years. Finally, she came out and she was a paraplegic for the rest of her life.

But during the interim of that, we got another bass player who was a New Yorker that was out of that same group of bass players that seemed to be all friends and buddies or comrades or whatever.
